terrainDescription.zh: 極度多山（天山山脈），伊塞克湖等高山湖泊
terrainDescription.en: Extremely mountainous (Tian Shan range), with alpine lakes such as Issyk-Kul

plate.shape: rectangular, 520×110mm, red vertical flag band on left

roadInfra.bollardStyle: White bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top; red-and-white triangle-patterned kilometer markers along roadsides are a fairly distinctive Kyrgyzstan clue

utilityPole.transformerMount: Square concrete poles as elsewhere in post-Soviet Central Asia; lower trunks of poles and roadside trees are frequently whitewashed

historicalContext.zh: 主體為吉爾吉斯人，歷史上以高山遊牧生活為主。
historicalContext.en: Majority Kyrgyz, with a historically nomadic, high-altitude pastoral culture.
